notes: The run localises the robot/machine pick-and-place cycles well in time (truth steps 5, 8, 10, 20) and the final worker pick-off at 164 s, but it calls the cups generic 'linh kiện/sản phẩm', labels the case packers as robots, and its key points never capture the multi-cup gripper or flap guides. It misses all worker preparation steps (aligning cups, placing on conveyor, lidding) and the whole carton-erecting stage, and hallucinates product handling during the robot test run, a 'pick from conveyor' when workers are placing cups, and packing into boxes at the end.
